source._comment: LIVE by county. NJ's Division of Elections publishes no pre-election mail-ballot counts (its county 'periodic reports' begin on Election Day). The UF Election Lab receives the state's figures directly and publishes them daily, including NJ_county.csv (21 counties x party: requested / returned / in-person). nj_update.py uses them unaltered, with attribution, under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (non-commercial); county rows must sum to the Lab's statewide row. Turnout % uses total registered by county from the NJ DOS monthly registration PDF.
